changes: New: 'In Progress Consults' resume feature for both Listing Consult and Repair Consult. Each sheet now checks on mount for the agent's own not-yet-finished consults (Listing: status='in_progress'; Repair: status in draft/quoted/sent) and, if any exist, shows a resume picker (client/src/components/ld/ConsultResumePicker.tsx) before the first wizard step instead of jumping straight in.

New backend endpoints: GET /api/listing-consult/mine, GET /api/repair-consult/mine (both list the current agent's resumable consults), and GET /api/repair-consult/:id (full row + checklist items fetch, mirroring the pre-existing GET /api/listing-consult/:id).

Resuming a picked consult hydrates every wizard field from the server (client/contact info, hero + gallery photos, checklist selections, and — for Listing Consult — every completed section's data) and lands the agent on the first incomplete step instead of the beginning.

Known, accepted limitation: Listing Consult's Lock In step only persists the derived accessNotes string server-side, not its six granular access fields (accessKeyOrCode, gateCode, ownerNames, ownerNames2, accessPhone, accessEmail) — those come back blank on resume even if previously filled. Documented in code, not silently patched.

RepairConsultSheet's nested-from-listing launch path (showRepairFromListing) is unaffected — it sets resumePhase directly to 'ready' and skips the resume check, since that flow is ephemeral to the current Listing Consult session and already creates its own linked record on mount.
__bundleNotes: No bundleMustNotContain guards: this release is purely additive (new endpoints + new picker UI layered in front of existing steps) — nothing was removed that would need an absence check.
